title: RAW intrinsic wind quality versus local warmth caused by its traversed land
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Md2 14r calls the same west wind cold/moist by nature but warm here because it crosses warm land. Preserve intrinsic quality, named path environment and locally experienced state; no simple opposite, seasonal reassignment or target meaning selection.

design.question: Can a multistep construction keep the same wind identity while intrinsic and locally experienced qualities differ, with the explicitly named traversed environment explaining the local quality?

source.native_status: Both whole institutional 1800px renditions hash-verified and viewed. Selective native readings, no OCR/crop, one already-owned witness.

Do not reconcile uncertain/crossed annular names or the apparent east moistness versus east-prose hot/dry by moving directions or importing a standard table.
Retain ambiguous east plural Die and north Der eyne; no automatic predicate inheritance by every companion.

proposed_content_schema.source_wording: Der ist kalt vnd fuchte / von siner nature Vnd / ist bi vns allewege warme / Das macht das er durch / warme lant gat
analytic_terms: Local or arriving state paraphrases bi vns; the source does not name a formal state variable.
The causal connection is explicit Das macht das, not inferred from mere adjacency.
Allewege is an explicit local generalization at bi vns, not a pair of observed episodes or a universal route law.
not_source_entailments: Exact heat-transfer mechanism, temperature magnitude, time lag or path length.
A prediction that every alternative route leaves the wind cold.
An automatic medical prescription from warmth.
Two observed before/after episodes or a universal rule for every wind and route.

connected_cases: One wind retains identity across nature, local condition and travel statements; changing owners discards the source anaphora.
Warmth of traversed land is the named explanatory intermediary for local warmth, while intrinsic cold/moist remains stated.
The south account names route and qualities/effects but lacks this same explicit causal connective; do not manufacture one uniform rule for all four entries.
rivals: One timeless unqualified wind-quality slot, making cold versus warm contradictory.
Pure intrinsic/ambient comparison without route-dependent explanation.
Simple reversal or season reassignment lacking the source land/traversal relation.
Renaming the arriving warm wind as a different wind.
costs: Any target application requires independently bound entity identity, path, local qualifier and causal wording; none is supplied here.
Source descriptions and diagram tensions cannot be silently unified.
This is historical causal content, not certification of modern meteorological truth.
